## Documentation change

This repository accepts documentation fixes only (no plugin source code).

**What does this change?**

**Files:**

- [ ] Documentation only (Markdown or images under `docs/` or the root files)
- [ ] I checked that links and menu, setting and command names are correct
- [ ] I did not add claims about features the plugin does not have
- [ ] I agree my change may be used under [LICENSE-docs.md](../LICENSE-docs.md)
